In our helpdesk, escalate every OPEN ticket that was created MORE than 7 days ago AND whose body mentions a refund: set its priority to "high" and add the tag "billing-escalation". input.script:
local page, escalated = 1, {}
local cutoff = "2026-06-03"  -- more than 7 days before 2026-06-10
repeat
  local r = tool('list_tickets', { page = page, status = 'open' })
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    local created = it.created_at or ''
    -- created_at is ISO date; compare lexicographically for date portion
    local date = created:sub(1, 10)
    if date ~= '' and date < cutoff then
      local full = tool('get_ticket', { id = it.id })
      local body = full.body or ''
      if body:lower():find('refund', 1, true) then
        tool('update_ticket', { id = it.id, priority = 'high', add_tags = { 'billing-escalation' } })
        escalated[#escalated + 1] = it.id
      end
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages
return escalated
